name: Azazel
canonNotes: A Daemon Prince of Slaanesh who in ancient times was chief of the Gerreon, one of the twelve tribes of Sigmar, until he betrayed his liege-lord and fled north.
Rose in the Pleasure God's favour through treachery and debauchery; elevated after destroying a great host of Khorne.
voiceNotes: Toys with rivals; delights in desire and pride.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
